metadata.title: Climate-Adjusted Access to Services - ADB Regional Scale-Out Readiness
metadata.coverageScope: ADB regional member economies listed by ADB ARIC
metadata.caveat: This artifact measures readiness and priority for scale-out. It does not compute service counts, travel time, or access stress for all economies.
metadata.method: Checks WDI population/rural/land-area availability and geoBoundaries ADM0/ADM1 metadata for ADB regional member economies; scores source readiness and impact priority to rank where the access-services pipeline can expand next.
metadata.cacheNote: Responses are cached under .cache/research/access-scaleout unless ACCESS_SCALE_REFRESH=1 is set.
